title: Design System: Joshua Alcobia Gomes — Portfolio

display.purpose: Hero headline, deck slide project titles. Archivo, weight 700. Tightest tracking in the system (-0.03em).

headline.purpose: Section headers on the home page. Archivo, weight 700.

body.purpose: All prose — about-me copy, project summaries, bullet lists. Inter, max readable measure ~65-75ch.

label.purpose: Field labels, nav links, buttons, index numbers, dates, footer fields. JetBrains Mono — used only for genuinely technical/data content, never as prose costume.

shadows.name: ambient-lg
shadows.purpose: Heaviest elevation — deck slide media. Reserved for the single most prominent element on screen.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Entrance and reveal motion — decelerating, no overshoot.

motion.name: spring
motion.purpose: Gentle-overshoot settle for section/slide entrances that follow a momentum gesture. Kept from the previous system — a motion decision independent of palette.

motion.name: deck-spring
motion.value: critically-damped spring, response ≈0.5s, damping 1.0 (JS-integrated, not CSS)
motion.purpose: Deck section-to-section snapping. Animates from the live scroll position, is interruptible mid-flight, and carries velocity through a re-target — the system's core fluid interaction, unchanged by the redesign.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Near-square ink-filled CTA — the system's highest-commitment action. Hover shifts fill to the accent blue.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .55rem; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-weight: 600; font-size: .92rem; padding: .78rem 1.2rem; border-radius: 3px; border: 1px solid #17181A; cursor: pointer; background: #17181A; color: #FAFAF8; transition: transform .2s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), background .2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #1D4FD1; border-color: #1D4FD1; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(.97); transition-duration: .09s; } .ds-arrow { transition: transform .3s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover .ds-arrow { transform: translateX(4px); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Outline-only secondary action, used alongside a primary button.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .55rem; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-weight: 600; font-size: .92rem; padding: .78rem 1.2rem; border-radius: 3px; border: 1px solid #B9BAB5; cursor: pointer; background: transparent; color: #17181A; transition: border-color .2s, transform .2s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: #17181A; } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: scale(.97); }

components.description: Home-page navigation card linking to a project chapter. A mono corner reference code (M · 01) replaces the previous emoji icon and the previous above-heading category kicker; an accent rule draws in across the top edge on hover via transform, never a gradient tint.

components.css: .ds-card { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: .6rem; overflow: hidden; padding: 1.5rem; border-radius: 3px; border: 1px solid #D9D9D4; background: #FFFFFF; min-height: 220px; text-decoration: none; color: inherit; transition: transform .3s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), box-shadow .3s cubic-bezier(.22,.61,.36,1), border-color .2s; } .ds-card::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; height: 2px; background: #1D4FD1; transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; transition: transform .35s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: 0 6px 20px -8px rgba(23,24,26,.18); border-color: #B9BAB5; } .ds-card:hover::before { transform: scaleX(1); } .ds-card-code { position: absolute; top: 1.1rem; right: 1.1rem; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: .72rem; font-weight: 600; color: #6A6D70; border: 1px solid #D9D9D4; border-radius: 2px; padding: .18rem .45rem; } .ds-card h3 { position: relative; z-index: 1; font-family: 'Archivo', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.4rem; margin: .2rem 0 0; } .ds-card-tag { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: .8rem; color: #6A6D70; } .ds-card p { color: #6A6D70; font-size: .93rem; margin: 0; } .ds-card-go { margin-top: auto; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .45rem; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-weight: 600; font-size: .88rem; color: #17181A; }

components.name: Chip
components.description: Small hairline-bordered tag for skills and project focus labels. Near-zero radius, mono type.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-block; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: .8rem; font-weight: 500; padding: .35rem .7rem; border-radius: 2px; background: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #D9D9D4; color: #40434A; }

components.name: Navigation Bar
components.description: Sticky solid-paper nav (no blur, no translucency — a deliberate reversal of the previous glass chrome) with a scaleX-drawn underline on the active/hovered link.

components.css: .ds-nav { position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 90; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1rem; padding: .85rem 2rem; background: #FAFAF8; border-bottom: 1px solid #D9D9D4; } .ds-nav-brand { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .6rem; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-weight: 600; font-size: .95rem; } .ds-nav-mark { width: 30px; height: 30px; border-radius: 2px; display: grid; place-items: center; background: #17181A; color: #FAFAF8; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-weight: 700; font-size: .8rem; } .ds-nav-links { display: flex; } .ds-nav-links a { position: relative; padding: .5rem .75rem; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: .88rem; font-weight: 500; color: #6A6D70; text-decoration: none; transition: color .25s; } .ds-nav-links a::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: .75rem; right: .75rem; bottom: .28rem; height: 1px; background: #1D4FD1; transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; transition: transform .3s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-nav-links a:hover, .ds-nav-links a[aria-current='page'] { color: #17181A; } .ds-nav-links a:hover::after, .ds-nav-links a[aria-current='page']::after { transform: scaleX(1); }

components.name: Deck Progress Rail
components.description: A ruler-tick scale bar (not a pill list) tracking scroll position through a project page's deck. Ticks grow via transform: scaleX(), never width, and take the accent color when active. Signature navigation component.
components.css: .ds-rail { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: .5rem; margin-top: 1.1rem; } .ds-rail-tick { width: 26px; height: 2px; background: #B9BAB5; opacity: .8; border: 0; padding: 0; cursor: pointer; transform: scaleX(.5); transform-origin: left; transition: transform .3s cubic-bezier(.22,.61,.36,1), background .3s, opacity .3s; } .ds-rail-tick:hover { transform: scaleX(.75); } .ds-rail-tick.ds-active { transform: scaleX(1); background: #1D4FD1; opacity: 1; }

components.name: Title-Block Footer Strip
components.description: A direct borrow from an engineering drawing sheet's own title block: a row of small mono fields separated by hairline dividers, closing every page. Replaced a plain copyright line.

components.css: .ds-tb-strip { border-top: 1px solid #B9BAB5; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; } .ds-tb-field { padding: .8rem 1.2rem; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: .8rem; color: #6A6D70; border-left: 1px solid #B9BAB5; } .ds-tb-field:first-child { border-left: 0; padding-left: 0; } .ds-tb-field b { color: #17181A; font-weight: 600; margin-right: .35rem; }

narrative.overview: The portfolio reads as an engineer's drawing sheet, not a lifestyle brand. Precision and hairline clarity replace pastel decoration as the source of warmth: graphite ink on paper, one blueprint-blue accent used exactly where it earns attention, a real title-block footer, a ruler-tick progress rail, and crosshair registration marks borrowed from print/plate conventions. This is a redesign — the previous 'Sage & Sky' pastel system is fully superseded, per Joshua's 2026-08-19 design-interview answer describing a 'clean, white and grey... schematic drawings and sketches on paper... like an engineer' direction, confirmed the same day. Only the spring-physics deck navigation and instant press feedback survive from the previous system, kept deliberately as motion decisions independent of palette.
keyCharacteristics: Restrained palette: near-black graphite ink on off-white paper and paper-grey, with exactly one accent (blueprint ink-blue) — never a second competing hue.
Hairline rules everywhere; near-zero corner radius; no soft glow, no glass blur, no gradients (text or fill).
Archivo for display type, JetBrains Mono for every label/index/date/field (earned technical use, not a costume), Inter for body prose.
A pinned, one-project-per-viewport 'deck' for project pages, with a ruler-tick progress rail and the same spring-physics section snapping as before.
A title block in the footer, in the direct tradition of an engineering drawing sheet's own closing strip.
No kicker/eyebrow ever sits above a heading — classification labels follow their heading or live in a corner reference tag.

rules.name: The One-Accent Rule
rules.body: Blueprint blue is the system's only color beyond the ink/paper neutral scale. Color commits through hairline precision and mono labeling, not through hue variety.

rules.name: No Gradients, Ever
rules.body: Not on text, not on fills, not on buttons. Emphasis comes from weight, color, or a hairline rule instead.

rules.name: Labels Follow Headings, Never Precede Them
rules.body: A kicker sitting above a heading and restating it is refused categorically. Where a heading needs a classification, that label follows it as a subtitle line, or is displaced into a corner reference tag — never stacked above it.

rules.name: Hairline Before Shadow
rules.body: Every panel gets a 1px border first; shadow is additive, never the sole separator. No backdrop blur or glass translucency anywhere in this system.

dos: Do keep all body/heading text on the Ink → Soft Ink → Muted scale; never introduce a separate gray family.
Do use JetBrains Mono only for genuinely technical/data content — never as a costume on prose.
Do give every interactive element instant :active press feedback (scale, not a delayed transition).
Do let project media keep its native aspect ratio, hairline border, no cropping.
Do animate width/height-affecting states via transform: scaleX(), never width/height directly.
Do mark unfinished projects/pages explicitly (dashed hairline border, placeholder styling) rather than disguising them as complete.
Do place a category/classification label after its heading, or displace it into a corner reference tag — never as a kicker above it.
donts: Don't use a pill/fully-rounded shape anywhere — the previous system's universal pill language is retired.
Don't use a gradient on text or on any fill.
Don't add backdrop blur or glass translucency — every surface is solid.
Don't put a kicker/eyebrow label directly above a heading, under any circumstance.
Don't use an emoji as an icon — replaced by mono corner reference codes.
Don't crop a project photo or video into a fixed box; size the frame to the media.
Don't fabricate metrics, testimonials, or client claims.
